name: Garage piano stabs
desc: Bright offbeat piano 7th stabs, Todd Edwards style: G major I-vi-IV-V (Gmaj7 Em7 Cmaj7 D7), octave-echo canon, reversed phrase every 8 bars, slow filter shimmer. Clipped so nothing smears.

code.full: n("<[0,2,4,6] [5,7,9,11] [3,5,7,9] [4,6,8,10]>").scale("${root}${oct}:${mode}").struct("[~ x] [~ x] [~ x] [x ~]").s("piano").clip(1).lpf(sine.range(${cut}*.4, ${cut}).slow(16)).gain(saw.range(${gain}*.6, ${gain}).fast(4)).room(.25).off(1/8, x=>x.add(note(12)).gain(.2)).every(8, rev).orbit(4).play()
code.peak: n("<[0,2,4,6] [5,7,9,11] [3,5,7,9] [4,6,8,10]>").scale("${root}${oct}:${mode}").struct("[x [~ x]] [~ x] [~ [x x]] [x ~]").s("piano").clip(1).lpf(sine.range(${cut}*.7, ${cut}*1.5).slow(8)).gain(saw.range(${gain}*.55, ${gain}).fast(4)).room(.2).off(1/8, x=>x.add(note(12)).gain(.22)).lastOf(4, x=>x.fast(2)).orbit(4).play()
